tasks.short: Receive and clarify steam-plant operating instructions

steps.what: Receive instructions from steam engineers and clarify steam plant or air compressor operations

tasks.design: Keep receipt and clarification of instructions between the engineers. Consult the controlled instruction record in {DOCS} during that exchange.
tasks.previous_blocker: An instruction must be understood in the context of the actual plant state.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing controlled records can support the exchange without a new instruction interpreter.
tasks.still_hard: Ambiguous scope, changed conditions and knowing when clarification is needed.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer checks understanding directly with the person giving the instruction.

reach.task: Explain the operating instruction and its limits

evidence.claim: Receiving and clarifying operational instructions is a contextual exchange; digital log capability does not establish a saving in this exchange.

assumptions: Boundary is receiving and understanding instructions, not carrying out operations or writing a handover report.

Steam engineer produces the instruction and plant context; stationary engineer verifies equipment identity, scope, limits and unresolved questions during s1. No ready understood or safe-to-operate flag is assumed.
Use the existing controlled record first.
Incremental upkeep is zero because no new instruction service is introduced.
research_questions: Which instructions most often need clarification before operations can proceed?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; zero gross and net saving. Direct instruction receipt and clarification retain their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Check ventilation air quality and adjust the system

steps.what: Check ventilation air quality against applicable requirements and actual operating conditions
Adjust ventilation controls and recheck air quality against the applicable requirements

tasks.design: Retain actual air-quality checks and adjustment with the engineer. Use {OTHER}, ventilation instruments and controls, with current requirements in {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual ventilation performance depends on measurement, location and operating conditions.
tasks.enabler_now: Current instruments and controls support the work; no new ventilation retrofit is proposed.
tasks.still_hard: Representative measurements, instrument validity and adjustments that affect several spaces.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer relates readings to actual conditions and verifies the result after adjustment.

reach.task: Clarify applicable requirements and escalation arrangements

evidence.claim: Physical ventilation checks and adjustment require valid measurements and contextual judgement; no saving is established by logbook software.

assumptions: Boundary is checking, adjustment and rechecking, not preparing a separate compliance report.

Engineer measures and records location, time, instrument identity, readings, units and operating conditions in s1. Responsible facilities specialist supplies applicable requirements; s1 includes confirming them. No ready compliant-air or adjustment-success flag is assumed.
Use existing instruments and controls first; existing controller runtime earns no labour saving.
Incremental upkeep is zero because no new measurement or control automation is introduced.
research_questions: Which air-quality concerns require fresh measurements rather than existing control-system values?

already_counted.description: Measurement, applicability assessment, adjustment and rechecking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=60+40=100; zero gross and net saving. Physical checking and adjustment retain their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Supervise assistant engineers and equipment operators

steps.what: Supervise assistant engineers, turbine operators, boiler tenders and refrigeration operators during actual work

tasks.design: Keep live supervision with the engineer. Use existing plans in {PROJECT} and procedures in {DOCS} while observing and directing the work.
tasks.previous_blocker: Supervision depends on actual work conditions and the people doing the work.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing plans support coordination without a new worker-allocation or monitoring system.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising uncertainty, conflicting priorities and work that needs intervention.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer coaches staff and intervenes when the actual situation changes.

evidence.claim: Live technical supervision is not removed by a project view or logbook; no independent administrative saving is established.

assumptions: Boundary is live direction and supervision, not a separate roster-production process.
Engineer observes the work and asks staff about progress and uncertainty within s1. No free worker-readiness, competence or work-complete flags are assumed.
Use current plans and procedures first; no staff ranking or automated assignment is proposed.
Incremental upkeep is zero because no new supervision system is introduced.
research_questions: Which supervision problems require direct observation or staff discussion?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; zero gross and net saving. Live supervision retains its time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Investigate accidents and prepare a checked report

steps.what: Investigate accidents through site observations, witness discussions and review of operating records
Draft an accident report from the checked evidence and investigator's assessed findings

loop.purpose: Organise established investigation evidence and findings into a report draft
loop.input: Checked evidence, findings and unresolved questions from s1
loop.output: Draft report with each factual statement linked to a source
loop.check: Engineer checks event sequence, witness attribution, uncertainty and causal wording against the actual evidence
loop.stop: One draft and one revision; unsupported causes remain unresolved and are written manually
loop.why_not_simpler: Narrative evidence and qualified findings need contextual expression beyond fixed fields

steps.what: Check the complete accident report and issue the exact reviewed version internally

tasks.design: Use a bounded assistant in {DOCS} to draft from checked evidence, including relevant {OPS_SYSTEM} records. The engineer retains investigation, causal assessment and final internal report review.
tasks.previous_blocker: Writing a clear report from mixed evidence can take repeated drafting.
tasks.enabler_now: A document assistant can organise established findings without making the investigation decision.
tasks.still_hard: Incomplete evidence, conflicting accounts and unsupported causal claims.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer tests explanations against physical evidence and records uncertainty honestly.
tasks.altitude: Reduce report wording effort while retaining investigation responsibility.

reach.task: Review findings and coordinate required follow-up
reach.learn: Which unresolved questions need additional investigation

evidence.claim: A reviewed draft can organise established accident findings; the digest's shift-log capabilities do not establish automated accident investigation.

assumptions: Boundary is investigation and an internal report, not emergency response or a statutory external notification. Immediate required reporting must not wait for this draft.

Engineer produces the checked evidence and findings in s1, recording event times, equipment identifiers, observation and witness references, record versions and explicit uncertainties. Missing facts remain questions; no free root-cause or verified-account flag is assumed.
Witnesses provide their accounts during s1; any extra interview remains investigation time rather than an automated saving.
Test existing document assistance first and confirm access and applicable employee consultation for new uses of incident records.
unknowns: Required internal review and external notification routes
research_questions: Does reviewed drafting reduce wording effort without strengthening unsupported causal conclusions?

incremental.description: Maintain report instructions and sample evidence attribution

approvals.approved_version: Exact report text, evidence references, assessed findings and unresolved questions; any revision voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=60+17.5+15=92.5; gross 7.5 minus focal upkeep 4 gives net 3.5 in an E1 scenario. Range 0-1 allows rare accidents, short reports and substantial evidence corrections.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce limited report wording effort while retaining live plant work, supervision and investigation.
reach: Review accident evidence with safety specialists
skills_to_grow: Keep uncertainty explicit in investigation records
role.ambitious_version: An engineer with clear investigation reports who retains time and responsibility for actual plant conditions and people.
